_doc: Time of day and weather: how a match looks, never how it plays (views only, not in the online data hash; online matches always use day + clear). An arena lists which of these it allows with "times" / "weathers"; without them it gets "defaults". Read by WeatherView (src/view/weather_view.gd); keys in data/CLAUDE.md.

sunset.name: Sunset
sunset._doc: warm low sun: the floor and stands warm, fighters a touch warm, shadows long and raking sideways

night.name: Night
night._doc: dark ambient over the floor and the stands, cut by floodlight pools; fighters keep at least fighter_min of their brightness, full inside a pool

rain.name: Rain
rain._doc: falling streaks (the look of Culvert's Rain Dance), splashes and ripples on the floor, an overcast tint, soft shadows; butterflies and dragonflies shelter

fog.name: Fog
fog._doc: low bands drifting over the floor, under the fighters, at low alpha; pale and soft

wind.name: Wind
wind._doc: debris blowing across (leaves on grass, paper and sand on dirt, grit on stone, paper on concrete); the map's own motes go faster

snow.name: Snow
snow._doc: light flakes drifting down; a cold pale tint
